subject: maths
question:
If the mode of the following data is 165, then what is the value of x?

 
 

 Class
 150-155
 155-160
 160-165
 165-170
 170-175
 
 
 
 

 Frequency
 13
 26
 37
 x
 27
solution:
**Given:**

Class intervals: 150-155, 155-160, 160-165, 165-170, 170-175

Frequencies: 13, 26, 37, x, 27

Mode = 165

**Formula used:**

Mode = L + [(fₘ - f₁) / (2fₘ - f₁ - f₂)] × h

Where:

 
• L = lower boundary of modal class
 
• fₘ = frequency of modal class
 
• f₁ = frequency of class preceding modal class
 
• f₂ = frequency of class succeeding modal class
 
• h = class width

**Calculation:**

Modal class = 165-170 (since Mode = 165, and 165 is in this class).

L = 165, fₘ = x, f₁ = 37, f₂ = 27, h = 5

Substitute values into the formula:

165 = 165 + [(x - 37) / (2x - 37 - 27)] × 5

⇒ 165 - 165 = [(x - 37) / (2x - 64)] × 5

⇒ 0 = [(x - 37) / (2x - 64)] × 5

⇒ (x - 37) = 0

⇒ x = 37

**∴ The correct answer is option (4).**
